Package controller

Class CareerStaffController

java.lang.Object
controller.CareerStaffController
public class CareerStaffController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling all business logic for a Career Staff user. This includes managing company representative approvals, internship approvals, student withdrawal requests, and generating comprehensive reports.
Version:
1.0
